parameters.name: CACertificate
parameters.description: The information about the CA certificate.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the CA certificates.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2401682~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.
